newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices steady in dull trade.

text.p: Cotton prices were steady in dull trade on Thursday on poor mill demand, dealers said.
They said yarn prices in international markets were recovering after a recent slide.
"But demand for cotton from local mills is yet to pick up," said a trader.
In Ready delivery, Gujarat Kalyan was steady at 13,200 rupees per candy (355.56 kg). Gujarat Wagad was unchanged at 12,600 rupees per candy.
Bengal-deshi was steady at 890 rupees per maund (37.32 kg).
